purpose: Fixed getopts local scanner and clustered-error followup; actual observations remain separate. No VM/history/baseline claim.

cases.purpose: Different parent offset2 and child offset1; discriminate restoration from coincident offsets.
cases.source:
getopts abc opt -abc; getopts abc opt -abc; rc=$?; printf 'parent-before|rc=%s|opt=<%s>|ind=%s|arg-count=%s|arg=<%s>
' "$rc" "$opt" "$OPTIND" "${#OPTARG[@]}" "$OPTARG"; f() { local OPTIND=1; local opt; getopts xyz opt -xyz; rc=$?; printf 'child|rc=%s|opt=<%s>|ind=%s|arg-count=%s|arg=<%s>
' "$rc" "$opt" "$OPTIND" "${#OPTARG[@]}" "$OPTARG"; }; f; getopts abc opt -abc; rc=$?; printf 'parent-next|rc=%s|opt=<%s>|ind=%s|arg-count=%s|arg=<%s>
' "$rc" "$opt" "$OPTIND" "${#OPTARG[@]}" "$OPTARG"

cases.purpose: Same unequal offsets with explicit return3; discriminate scope-exit paths.
cases.source:
getopts abc opt -abc; getopts abc opt -abc; rc=$?; printf 'parent-before|rc=%s|opt=<%s>|ind=%s|arg-count=%s|arg=<%s>
' "$rc" "$opt" "$OPTIND" "${#OPTARG[@]}" "$OPTARG"; f() { local OPTIND=1; local opt; getopts xyz opt -xyz; rc=$?; printf 'child|rc=%s|opt=<%s>|ind=%s|arg-count=%s|arg=<%s>
' "$rc" "$opt" "$OPTIND" "${#OPTARG[@]}" "$OPTARG"; return 3; }; f; printf 'function-status=%s
' "$?"; getopts abc opt -abc; rc=$?; printf 'parent-next|rc=%s|opt=<%s>|ind=%s|arg-count=%s|arg=<%s>
' "$rc" "$opt" "$OPTIND" "${#OPTARG[@]}" "$OPTARG"
